direction.name: The printed annual
direction.idea: Lay the page out like a well-designed printed report or magazine feature: a masthead image, a tight oversized title, text held to a strict column line, and colour used in solid blocks the way a two-colour print job would. It gives weight and authority to subjects that are really about content: findings, a manifesto, a programme, a serious product. The reader should feel that someone edited this.
direction.composition: A fixed vertical axis at about 42% of the viewport width organises everything: headings begin on it, body columns hang from it, and the 0–42% zone holds small side notes, figures or stays empty. Masthead: a wide image band (photographic mosaic or a single crop) across the top 45% of the first screen; below it the title at 7–9vw starting on the axis, with a two-sentence standfirst at 20–24px. Sections alternate between text pages (title on the axis, body in one or two columns of 34–40ch to its right) and full-bleed colour pages carrying one large figure, quotation or image mosaic. Mosaics are gutterless: photographs and flat colour tiles butted together in a 4- or 6-cell grid. Page numbers, running heads and other print furniture are left out.
direction.typography: A tight heavy grotesk or a sharp serif for titles; an excellent text face for reading at 18–20px with leading near 1.5. Headings in sentence case, tracked tight.
direction.colour: Paper, ink and two or three solid block colours. A colour page is a whole section in one flat colour.
direction.imagery: Photographs used as blocks in mosaics alongside flat colour tiles; mixed subjects are fine if cropped tight and converted to one treatment.
direction.photoTreatment: Give all photographs in a mosaic one treatment: greyscale via `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)`, or all full colour. Do not mix.
direction.richness: The column line, the mosaics and whole pages of colour give structure and variety without ornaments.
direction.pitfalls: The axis must be exact and reused everywhere or it reads as random indentation. Keep paragraphs to a real reading measure. On a phone the axis collapses to the left margin and side notes move inline above their paragraph.

hero.name: Mosaic masthead, title on axis
hero.blueprint: The top 52% of the viewport is a full-width masthead band built as a gutterless mosaic: a CSS grid of 6 columns and 2 rows in which four cells are photographs (object-fit: cover, all greyscale via filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)) and the rest are flat tiles in two or three palette colours. One photograph spans two columns and one colour tile spans both rows; cells butt together with no gap. The header lies flush on the band's upper edge: the wordmark in a solid ink block at far left, a flat accent-coloured tab holding three text links that runs from the block to 42% of the width, and the single action as a text link at the far right. Below the band, on the paper ground: a standfirst of one sentence at 20px on the 16px left margin, max 30ch, and, starting exactly at 42% of the width, the title on two lines at clamp(64px, 8.3vw, 128px), medium weight, tracking -0.06em, leading 0.9, running to the right margin. The title's first baseline sits about 110px under the band.
hero.mobile: The band becomes a mosaic of 3 columns and 2 rows taking the top 38% of the screen: two photographs and four colour tiles. The header is a single row above it with the wordmark block and a menu word. The axis collapses to the 16px left margin: the title at 13vw on two lines, then the standfirst at 17px beneath it. The action sits as a text link at the foot of the screen.
hero.headline: The title of the report, programme or product, 2-5 words, at most 26 characters across two lines.

photos.title: Architecture
photos.note: structure, lines, bridges, facades and building interiors
photos.treatment: Give all photographs in a mosaic one treatment: greyscale via `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)`, or all full colour. Do not mix.

motion.name: Masked headline
motion.description: On load, each line of the headline rises from behind its own baseline, about 900ms with a strong ease-out, the second line 110ms after the first; the supporting sentence and the action then fade up together. Nothing else on the page performs. Because headlines are two lines at most, you author the line breaks and wrap each line yourself. Recipe: 'Masked line reveal' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Square plate, spare text
sections.blueprint: One flat field split 50/50, at least 88svh tall. Left half: a single square photograph filling the half's width minus 40px margins, vertically centred, square corners. A large simple shape may be laid over it to turn the photograph into the object it stands for: a ring 86% of its width with a 6px stroke and a small solid dot at the centre makes a record; a notch cut by clip-path makes a ticket stub. Right half, a flex column with space-between: at the top a row of three plain text tabs at 18px (editions, years, variants), the active one in full ink and the others at 40%; in the middle the title, two to four words at 32–40px bold, with a 34ch description 48px below; along the bottom two filled rectangular cells side by side, each half the column wide and 72px tall, acting as the two actions, one in ink and one a tone off the field.
sections.mobile: The square photograph comes first at full width with 16px margins. The tabs sit under it as one row at 17px. Then the title at 28px, the description, and the two action cells stacked, each full width and 60px tall.

sections.name: Mosaic of unlike tiles
sections.blueprint: A 12-column grid with 8px gaps and rows of 96px, filled with no empty cells and no outlines. Six to eight filled tiles in four sizes only: 6×5, 6×3, 3×3 and 3×2 (columns × rows). The rule that keeps it from being a card grid: no two neighbouring tiles hold the same kind of thing. One tile is the heading alone, two to four words at 4vw, top-left. One is a photograph covering its tile. One is a single figure at 6vw with a caption. One is a short list of four lines at 20px. The others are a single sentence each at 28–32px. Text sits top-left with 24px padding; tiles holding one sentence leave their lower half empty. Tile fills: the ground one tone darker, two palette colours, and photographs. One corner radius everywhere, either 0 or 8px.
sections.mobile: Two columns with 6px gaps. The heading tile and the photograph tile span both columns; sentence tiles span both at their natural height; the figure and list tiles sit side by side as a pair of squares. Order: heading, photograph, pair, sentence, sentence.

sections.name: Many into one
sections.blueprint: A diagram drawn with one repeated shape instead of arrows. The heading (two to four words on two lines at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px)) and a short paragraph at 17px sit in columns 1–4. Beneath, a wide inline SVG spans columns 1–12 at about 4.5:1. It is built from 120–160 small filled squares (or the page's own motif), each 10–14px. In the left third they are scattered loosely in two pale tones. In the middle third they are pulled into a tight horizontal ribbon three squares high. In the right third they fan out again into neat, evenly spaced rows in the accent colour. The eye reads disorder, compression, order, from left to right. Under the diagram, three text columns aligned to its thirds: a bold one-word name at 20px and two lines at 16px each; the words carry the sequence ('Gather', 'Reduce', 'Release'). No connecting marks.
sections.mobile: The diagram turns to run top to bottom: a 3:4 SVG with the scatter at the top, the ribbon as a vertical band in the middle and the ordered rows at the bottom. The three names and their text sit to its right in a 38vw column, each level with its zone.

sections.name: Side facts, wide paragraph
sections.blueprint: Two rows share one vertical line at 34% of the viewport width. Row one: in a 160px column at the left margin, three label and value pairs stack with 20px between them, each a label in the soft ink with its value beneath in full ink, all at 13px (founded, based in, team size). From the 34% line a five-line paragraph at clamp(20px, 1.7vw, 26px), leading 1.35, runs to 90% of the width. Row two starts 120px lower and repeats the logic for the record of the practice: one plain word at 13px at the far left (awards, press, clients), then from the 34% line two list columns, each 260px wide with a 64px gutter, at 13px with 10px between lines: name at the left, year at the right in the soft ink. No heading; the paragraph opens the section. Each list comfortably holds 6–12 lines. No photographs are needed.
sections.mobile: Everything aligns to the left margin. The paragraph comes first at 19px. The three label and value pairs follow as a two-column grid at 14px. The two record lists stack with 40px between them, each opened by its plain word in full ink.

sections.name: Two plans, two fields
sections.blueprint: Two plans stand side by side as two full-height colour fields that meet at a hard vertical edge with no gap: the left field spans columns 1–5, the right 6–12, both 90svh tall and bleeding to the viewport edges. Each field has its own flat colour and its assigned text colour. Inside each, on a shared grid: the plan name at about 5vw top-left with 40px padding; one sentence at 20px beneath it, no wider than 26ch, saying who the plan is for; then, anchored to the bottom-left, the price at about 10vw with the period at 18px beside it; and a rectangular button anchored bottom-right on the price's baseline. What is included is written as a short paragraph, not a tick list. The unequal widths say which plan matters more without any badge. No heading spans the two fields.
sections.mobile: The fields stack, each 70svh tall, the more important plan first. Name at 12vw top-left, sentence beneath, price at 24vw at the bottom-left, and the button full width along the bottom edge inside 20px padding. The hard colour edge between the two is kept.

sections.name: Answers as reading text
sections.blueprint: The questions and answers are set as continuous reading text, like the notes at the back of a programme. A heading of two or three words at 28–32px sits in columns 1–3, top-aligned. Columns 5–12 hold the text in two columns (`columns: 2; column-gap: 56px`), each about 36ch wide, at 16–17px with leading 1.55. Each item is one paragraph: the question is the opening run-in, set in the medium weight in the full ink and ending with its question mark, and the answer continues on the same line in the regular weight. Paragraphs are separated by 20px and carry `break-inside: avoid` so none splits across columns. No toggles, no icons, no boxes. Eight to fourteen items fit on one screen, which is the point: everything is answered at a glance. Where the page's reading column is narrow, use one column.
sections.mobile: One column at 16px with 20px margins. The heading leads at 24px. Each paragraph keeps its run-in question in the medium weight, with 18px between paragraphs. The section may run to two screens; do not collapse it into an accordion.

sections.name: Three photographs, then a field
sections.blueprint: Two parts with no gap between them. First, a strip of three photographs butted edge to edge across the full viewport, each one third wide and 40svh tall, `object-fit: cover`, no gutters and no captions; give all three the same treatment. Directly beneath, a band in one flat palette colour, about 44svh tall. In the band, columns 1–7: the closing statement at 26–30px over three lines in the band's assigned ink, with exactly one phrase underlined by a 4px bar (`text-decoration-thickness: 4px; text-underline-offset: 6px`), and that phrase is the link; two lines at 16px follow 32px lower. In the lower-right corner, columns 11–12, a small portrait photograph (4:5, about 150px wide) sits 40px from the band's edges: the person who will answer. There is no button; the underlined phrase is the action.
sections.mobile: The strip becomes one full-width photograph at 4:3 with the other two side by side beneath it at half width each, still gutterless. The band follows: statement at 22px, the two small lines, and the portrait at 96px wide in the bottom-right corner.

sections.name: Columns above, wordmark below
sections.blueprint: The footer inverts ground and ink and fills a whole viewport (min-height 100svh), arranged as three rows in a grid (auto 1fr auto). Top row, 40px from the edge: four small columns on the 12-column grid (address, navigation, social, hours or contact), each a plain list at 15–16px with its first line in the full ink and the rest in the softer ink. Middle row: empty. Bottom row: the wordmark alone, sized to run from the left margin to the right margin on one line. Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune `font-size` in `vw` to the letter count, so it never wraps; its baseline sits 20px above a single line of legal text at 13px. With `position: sticky; bottom: 0` and a lower `z-index` than the page, the last section slides away to uncover it.
sections.mobile: Columns become two by two at 15px with 32px between rows, at the top. A gap of about 20svh follows. The wordmark spans the full width at the bottom; a name longer than ten letters stacks on two lines, each fitted to the width. Legal line beneath at 12px.

references.name: Ai in Design Report 2026
references.idea: A research report laid out like a colour-blocked print annual: a thermal-blurred video collage on top, an oversized tight grotesk title, and flat orange, lilac, sage and black blocks carrying stats, quotes and chapters.
references.hero: The top 53% is a full-width video band: blurred, heat-map-like abstract footage in orange, lilac and sage, overlaid with four or five hard-edged rectangles of the same footage in grey or green, two tagged with tiny mono labels in white boxes. The header sits flush on top: a black logo block at far left, an orange link tab running to 40% of the width, two plain links at right. Below the band, on white: a two-line deck at about 1.4vw on a 1% left margin, and from 42% across a two-line title at 8.3vw, medium weight, tracking -0.06em. Bottom row: mono credit left, scroll cue and arrow aligned to the title column.
references.type: Beausite Classic, a grotesk with some stroke contrast, in Medium for titles and Regular for text; sentence case, tracking -0.06em at display size. Geist Mono for small uppercase labels. Steps: 8.3vw title, about 5.5vw numerals, about 3vw statements, 16px body, 10px mono. Footer wordmark near 96vw.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #fe7141 #cdabfe #d1ddd3 #f0ff1c — White base with flat blocks of orange, lilac, sage and black assigned to whole modules (stat tiles, quote panels, chapter bands), all drawn from the hero footage. Text is black, or off-white on black.
references.imagery: Hero: abstract blurred video with a heat-map grade, cut into overlapping rectangles. Body: warm documentary photos and clips of people at desks in wood-lined rooms, square-cornered, butted directly against flat colour blocks with no gap.
references.layout: 1% margins and a recurring column line at about 42% where most headings and text begin. Open white text passages ruled by hairlines alternate with tight mosaics in which photos and colour blocks share edges. Each chapter opens with a full-width colour band.

sections.description: A full-width hairline, a tiny mono label at the left, then seven black partner logos evenly spaced across the full width in one row with generous padding above and below, closed by a second hairline. Immediately beneath, another mono label and a three-line statement at about 3vw, flush left and occupying only the left half, followed by a full-width photo strip.

A mosaic with no gutters. A photo of two people at a laptop fills the left two-thirds at roughly 1:1; the right third is split into two stacked flat tiles, lilac above and sage below. Each tile carries a large numeral with a plus sign at about 5.5vw in its top-left corner and a two-line caption directly beneath; the rest of the tile is empty colour.

Quote module as two abutting blocks: a black block on the left 40% holding only a small name and a mono role caption, and a sage block on the right 60% with the quotation at about 3vw, top-left aligned with empty sage beneath. Directly below, a full-width orange band opens a chapter: hairline at top, a large two-digit number with the chapter word under it at left, a two-line title and small paragraph starting at the 42% column.

Black footer. A row of three small source counts along the top, separated by vertical hairlines, then the report name in off-white heavy type at nearly full viewport width with a trademark sign at its top-right, then the year at the same size right-aligned on a second line. Two small link columns with mono headings sit lower left beside the year; a hairline and one row of credits and partner logos close it.

steal: Start most headings and text at a fixed column line about 42% across, leaving the left for small decks, credits and chapter numbers.
Butt flat colour tiles directly against a photograph with no gutter and put one large numeral plus two caption lines in each tile's top-left corner.
Take the page's flat block colours from the hero footage so the abstract video and the layout read as one palette.
references.media: A video collage covers 100% of the screen at load and lifts to the top ~53% to uncover the title on white. Below, a documentary photograph two thirds wide in a sticky frame beside stacked colour stat blocks, a pinned deck of colour cards each with a 10s clip docked bottom-left, and a carousel of equal stills running off the right edge: 12 images and 6 muted videos, all square-cornered.
references.motion: No preloader, but the collage re-cuts itself for about 4s before the title lands. Framer drives the sticky stacking (a 1350px photo frame and three 900px chapter cards that peel away to uncover the next); there is no split text, links change colour over .2s cubic-bezier(.44,0,.56,1), and one panel slides 610px in over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.44,0,0.37,1).

references.name: Architecture of Socialist-Era Belgrade
references.idea: A two-colour printed guidebook on screen: signal-red type over greyscale concrete, with one modular display face as the only ornament.
references.hero: Full-bleed greyscale photograph of brutalist housing towers; pale sky fills the top half, concrete the bottom. The title is set over the sky, flush left at a 32px margin, three lines in a wide modular display face at 102px (7.1vw) in flat red, the longest line reaching 92% of the width, leading so tight that the lines almost touch. Under it, one row at 24px: a red one-line descriptor at left, and two paler-red facts right-aligned (an object count and a date range). Top-right, the word 'Index' with a diagonal arrow. No logo, no button, nothing else. Red and grey only.
references.type: IntraNet, a wide modular display face with rounded, notched corners, used only for the title and its footer repeat. Funnel Sans carries the rest: about 50px for the long intro, 40px bold uppercase entry titles, 24px meta, 13px credits. Four sizes, two faces.
references.colour: #f53843 #d1d1d1 #c7c7c7 #777777 #f1a7ab — Strictly red and grey: red text on grey photo or grey paper, then pale grey text on a solid red field for the essay and footer. Photographs are desaturated so nothing breaks the pair.
references.imagery: Contemporary black-and-white architectural photographs of concrete towers and complexes, frontal or looking up, with big skies and visible grain; full-bleed in the hero, full column width and square-cornered in entries.
references.layout: 16 to 32px margins, everything flush left. A long red essay block in very large text, then twenty repeated entry blocks on grey: a two-column header split by a vertical red hairline, a meta row, then a wide photo. 81 screens of the same rhythm.

sections.description: Immediately under the hero photo a solid red field begins with no gap. The essay runs as one full-width column in pale grey sans at roughly 50px with tight leading, about 50 characters per line, paragraphs separated by one blank line, with no headings, pull-quotes or images for several screens. The photo's bottom edge butts straight against the red.

Each building entry sits on light grey paper: a thin red rule across the top, then two columns divided by a vertical red hairline at the 50% mark. Left: the building's name in red bold uppercase at 40px over two lines. Right: its dates in pale red at the same size. Below, a small meta row with 'Credits' and 'Address' labels and values in 13px red, then a full-width greyscale photograph.

Solid red. At the top, two short 13px notes side by side in pale grey occupy the left 60%, a back-to-top link sits far right, and a third note runs beneath. A tall empty red gap follows. Then the full title is repeated in the display face at hero size but in pale grey, flush left, above a single row of small meta: sources link left, font credits centre, city and year right.

steal: Limit the page to one saturated colour and one grey, desaturate all photos, and invert the pair (grey on red) for long reading blocks.
Set the title in a distinctive modular display face directly on the sky area of a photo and repeat it in the footer in the inverse colour.
Put facts in the hero as a right-aligned row of paler-tint figures (count, date range) on the same baseline as the subtitle.

references.name: Fynza
references.idea: Bookings are drawn as avatar dots whose orange flow lines merge into a single vertical spine, which then runs down the page as the axis for the partner list, the cash-flow timeline and the step cards.
references.hero: Warm grey ground with a fine white dot texture and a peach gradient bleeding down from the top edge. A floating white pill navbar 80% wide holds the logo left and a language switch plus outlined and orange pill buttons right. Centred stack: a white pill badge with overlapping partner-logo dots, a two-line extra-bold uppercase headline at 4.2vw in slate navy with two words in orange, two lines of grey 18px text, an orange pill button. Around the button five round avatar photos with small booking labels sit at staggered heights across the full width; thin orange curves, two dashed, flow down from each and converge at bottom centre.
references.type: Golos Text only: weight 800 uppercase at 60px for every section headline with slight negative tracking, 18px regular grey body, about 24px semibold for card titles, tiny uppercase captions. A wide extended logo wordmark. Roughly four sizes; hierarchy relies on weight and colour.
references.colour: #edecea #ffffff #f4bba8 #f2561d #3f4f6e #1a2e7a — Warm grey and white with peach gradients fading in at section tops and bottoms; orange carries buttons, flow lines and highlighted headline words; one deep royal-navy slab near the end.
references.imagery: Round avatar photos, partner logo discs, sunny travel photographs inside rounded cards with white UI snippets floating on top, and illustrated vintage postage stamps tilted and scattered around the final call to action.
references.layout: Centred container of about 1150px; every section opens with a small white pill label and a two-line uppercase headline. A single orange vertical line runs through the page centre linking hero, logo list, timeline and step cards. Sections alternate grey, peach fade and one navy slab.

sections.description: Directly under the hero the converged orange line becomes a vertical spine and partner brands hang off it in two columns: logo then name on the left, name then logo on the right. Rows are separated by dashed horizontal rules with small orange dots where they cross the spine. There is no heading, so it reads as a continuation of the hero diagram.

Problem timeline on the centre spine: small rounded-square chips labelled by week sit on the line. Events alternate left and right, each joined to its chip by a dashed horizontal line ending in a small coloured amount tag (red for outflow, green for income), with a bold label and two lines of grey text. A red-tinted rounded note sits on the spine as the conclusion while the background fades to saturated peach.

Three large white rounded cards stacked on the spine, each a two-column split that alternates sides: on one side an orange numbered disc, a three-line semibold title and a small grey paragraph; on the other a rounded travel photograph with a white UI card or a cluster of logo discs floating over it. The orange line passes behind the gaps between cards.

Dotted peach-to-white field with a centred two-line uppercase headline, one word in orange, and an orange pill button. Six illustrated vintage travel stamps and round stickers are scattered around it at slight rotations, three above and three below, some tucked under the navbar. A tiny two-line legal footer sits directly underneath, centred, with no separate footer band.

steal: Turn the hero illustration's lines into a page-long spine: let the curves converge at the fold and continue as the axis for the next section's list and timeline.
Show the customer's own unit of value (a booking with name, party size and price) as small avatar chips instead of a dashboard screenshot.
End on a themed sticker scatter (illustrated stamps at varied tilt) around the last call to action rather than a plain coloured band.
